brief:
Marwan Abu Ras, a member of the Palestinian Legislative Council, has issued a stark appeal regarding Gaza's deteriorating conditions, invoking religious scripture to frame the territory's suffering as a test of resolve. Writing under the byline of Dr. Marwan Abu Ras—Abu Assem, the legislator questioned where Palestinians could turn and appealed directly to Arab nations for assistance, Shehab Wire reported.

The appeal cites Quranic verse as the legislator addresses the humanitarian emergency facing Gaza's population.
dek: Marwan Abu Ras, a member of the Palestinian Legislative Council, has issued a stark appeal regarding Gaza's deteriorating conditions, invoking religious scripture to frame the territory's suffering as a test of resolve.
title: Palestinian legislator decries Gaza's humanitarian crisis, appeals to Arab states
